top.title: Taking Etihad Rail over the weekend? Everything you need to know to plan your travel
top.teaser: With two new stations now open, Etihad Rail has become far more accessible for UAE residents looking to explore the country by train. On Wednesday, the much-awaited Al Yalayis station in Dubai opened to public alongside the Al Dhaid station located in Sharjah. top.headline: New Etihad Rail Stations Open in Dubai and Sharjah
top.summary: Etihad Rail opened new stations at Al Yalayis in Dubai and Al Dhaid in Sharjah. High public demand prompted the expansion.
top.why: Improves regional connectivity and accessibility for residents.

top.title: Etihad Rail announces more trains between Abu Dhabi and Dubai to meet demand
top.teaser: Etihad Rail has added more than 2,000 tickets across six extra train services between Abu Dhabi and Dubai this weekend. The additional services were announced on Friday and were made available after the new passenger rail route connecting the UAE's biggest cities attracted “exceptional early demand”. top.headline: Etihad Rail Adds Extra Dubai and Abu Dhabi Services
top.summary: Six additional train services offering over 2,000 tickets have been added between Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The move follows exceptional early demand.
top.why: Demonstrates successful transport links between major UAE cities.

top.title: UAE Property: 'Who pays to install an EV charger at a rented villa?'
top.teaser: Question: I rent a villa in Dubai and recently bought an electric car. top.headline: Tenant Guidance Issued on Installing Villa EV Chargers
top.summary: A legal query addresses whether landlords or tenants are responsible for EV charger installation costs in rented villas. The situation highlights emerging property upgrade disputes.
